bio: Brilliant Mortgages (brilliantinvestor.ca) is a one-page GoDaddy site offering mortgage guidance for purchase, refinance and investment, with access to dozens of lenders. The footer names Robert Cheszes as mortgage agent under Mortgage Outlet Inc. and lists a Toronto address. It offers a mortgage-renewal tracker and a Calendly consult link.
